# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 40 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Lament; Seth Comforts Her

---

**1** Eve fell on her face and wept before the gate of paradise: 'O God, forgive me, for I have brought great sorrow upon all my children.'

**2** Seth came to Eve and comforted her: 'Mother, do not weep, for God is merciful to all who repent.'

**3** Eve said: 'O Seth, my son, who will comfort me in my old age? For I am alone.'

**4** Seth said: 'God will comfort you, mother, as he has comforted all who have called upon him.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
